episodes.synopsis: Noel is a boy who aims to become the strongest Seeker, but the class he is assessed as is Talker, the weakest of them all. As he fights alongside his party, Blue Beyond, he is limited to barking out orders--not directly participating in battle.
episodes.title: Why the Weakest Aims to be the Strongest

episodes.synopsis: Noel and Walter must come up with a plan to capture the runaway Lloyd and Tanya, and get their money back.
episodes.title: This Talker Is Ruthless

episodes.synopsis: Blue Beyond is reborn, but it won't get anywhere with Noel as its only member. So he puts out a call for new recruits, only to find an unexpected taker.
episodes.title: The Real Deal

episodes.synopsis: Noel and Alma head out on their first job, a request from a poor village chief to deal with a group of thieves giving them problems, but it doesn't go as hoped.
episodes.title: An Apology Won't Cut It

episodes.synopsis: Noel and Alma are back in Etria, and they decided to spend the day doing some much-needed shopping. However, their date runs into a few roadblocks on the way…
episodes.title: The Swordsman from the Far East

episodes.synopsis: Noel is having trouble finding new party members that meet his standards, but things take a dangerous turn when someone comes looking for him instead.
episodes.title: The Price of Honor

episodes.synopsis: After the scuffle, Noel decides to go into action to get his payback on the man who ordered his assassination, Albert Gambino.
episodes.title: World Without Honor or Humanity

episodes.synopsis: With Finocchio as witness, Noel has to face off against the representative of Albert Gaminbo's choosing, who happens to be a familiar face.
episodes.title: The Makings of a Champion

episodes.synopsis: Blue Beyond meets with the Inspector who will oversee their clan application, Harold Jenkins, who explains to them that the situation has changed.
episodes.title: The Snake Sharpens Its Fangs

episodes.synopsis: Noel sets his sights on the Winged Knights, who decide to take a step forward themselves.
episodes.title: The Haves and the Have-Nots

episodes.synopsis: Blue Beyond and the Winged Knights face off, and Noel has a plan to deal with the skill gap.
episodes.title: The Price of Being Right

episodes.synopsis: As the test comes to an end, Blue Beyond and the Winged Knights must come to terms with the aftermath.
episodes.title: The Snake Has Wings
